customers.evidence: Putting clients first, leading with exceptional ideas, doing the right thing and giving back.

employees.evidence: We believe our greatest asset is our people.

dei.evidence: Morgan Stanley is differentiated by the caliber of our diverse team. Our culture of access and inclusion has built our legacy and shapes our future

environment.evidence: We work to maximize capital to build a more sustainable future.

community.evidence: Our board of directors and senior executives hold the belief that capital can and should benefit all of society.

shareholders.evidence: Morgan Stanley has consistently delivered first-class business in a first-class way.

innovation.evidence: We offer scalable investment products, foster innovative solutions and provide actionable insights across sustainability issues.

result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational tone with absolute language ('Putting clients first', 'guided by our four core values'). Leads with clients, then diversity and community. Mostly third-person corporate voice, with some 'we believe' and 'we value' first-person framing. Safety is absent; integrity is thin, relying on the phrase 'doing the right thing'.
